title: Why Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Hired the Editor for the BBC’s hip-hop?
text:
June 10, 2018 Why Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Hired the Editor for the BBC’s hip-hop?
The popularity of Hip-hop is quickly becoming a key battleground, for the rest of streaming music companies like YouTube and Spotify, that have been poaching the influencers in a bid to become more attractive to tastemakers and also to lure millions of listeners. In this streaming music scenario, the presence of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) is certainly no exception.
As to get the business up, Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has hired Ryan Newman, the Editor for the BBC’s hip-hop, and the grime-focused Radio 1Xtra. According to Music Business Worldwide Ryan Newman was responsible for creating and implementing the station’s strategy, suggesting that at Apple , he will have a to perform on a same role at Apple Music, for boosting its on-demand streaming, its Beats 1 station or both.
The company also recruited Radio 1’s Zane Lowe, which is one of the main DJs at Beats 1, and BBC’s Hip-Hop editor is not only the target, and the strategy behind poaching that talent is the Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s struggle to lead the streaming music business with latest trends and it’s not taking any risk to lose its valuable influence in the urban music. About Kevin Frahm
